Sophie and Ryan damage the Moon Pool in their efforts to obtain the rare crystals. The girls improvise and use their own magic to prevent the impact of the comet and a planet wide catastrophe. Rikki, Cleo and Bella graduate with a surprise.
Cleo and Emma meet new girl, Rikki, and find themselves stuck on Mako Island where they are transformed into mermaids. As well as growing tails, the girls find they have powers over water.

Annoying Miss Popularity, Miriam, is having a pool party and the girls want to go. But being around water is risky, especially when Zane tosses Cleo into the pool. Lewis is the only one around to help so he finds out their secret.

Rikki, Emma and Cleo discover that sea turtles are being captured by fishing nets. When Rikki and Emma attempt to rescue the turtles by cutting the nets, it causes the fisherman to think that there is a rogue shark roaming their ocean.

Emma decides that she is not going to have her annual sleepover party due to what has happened to them. But Rikki and Cleo try to convince her otherwise. Meanwhile, Lewis conducts experiments on the girls.

Cleo's sister Kim finds her diary and thinks that Cleo and her friends are 'evil mermaids' and she plans to tell everyone. Meanwhile, Lewis goes to Mako Island to find out more about what happened to the girls.

Down in the Netherworld, anticipation is building for a witch-specific holiday (like our Valentine’s Day or Halloween – like Mardi Gras, with everyone wearing masks).
Using typical teenage bad judgment, Sabrina starts repeating a rumor she has heard from Tiffany & Margaux. It’s a fairly hurtful sort of rumor about one of their classmates.
When practical joker Reggie scares Archie with a Wolfman mask, his prank backfires!
One night, a bright, and glittering shopping mall mysteriously appears in Riverdale.
Government agents are convinced by Jughead's eccentric behavior that he is an advance scout for an alien invasion fleet.
Under the influence of a Full Moon, the girls' powers are hugely enhanced and they wreak havoc on Lewis in his boat. The next day the girls realise they still need Lewis.
Emma uses her new powers to help Elliott win at soccer. Lewis decides to test the girls' increased powers. Cleo has had enough of Lewis' smothering and dumps him. Lewis meets Charlotte and they bond.
Zane’s back in town and still in love with Rikki. He works out she’s still a mermaid and tries to win her back. Cleo becomes suspicious of Lewis spending time with Charlotte.
Rikki comes to stay at Emma’s house and stirs up the family unit. In trying to compete with Rikki, Emma tries to rebel and throws a party. Nate uses Lewis to make a play for Cleo.

Lewis finds an old book on mermaids and tests out a potion recipe on the girls. Cleo tries to get Don and her Mum together by using her powers to grant him a wish. Realising it’s not what he wants, she finally accepts the situation.
Marshall is love's reluctant mail carrier when the ghost of a 1920s smitten teen demands that Marshall delivers a love letter to the spirit's dreamgirl, now an elderly woman.
Marshall needs to be saved from daylight savings (which isn't in effect in Eerie) after he resets his time and falls into a dimension always one hour behind.
Seventeen year old Nathan is a star athlete who would do anything to play pro basketball.
Convinced that his Aunt Melva is too old and helpless to live on her own, a young city boy named Dale drives out to the "sticks" to retrieve her.
When surfer dudes Ben and Mike mistakenly travel to Austria instead of Australia, they find themselves aboard the midnight run of the Translyvania Express railway.

Cassy is assigned to tend the school garden, where she discovers that the flowers are shrinking instead of growing. While trying to save a flower, she's yanked into “Rootopia,” – a bizarre underground realm.
A film about a mean and violent werewolf is shot in Wolverton. Outraged by the poor misrepresentation of werewolves, Scott decides to be a stuntman in order to change the horror film into a comedy.
Scott becomes infatuated with Shayna the She-Wolf, a T.V. personality who he believes to be a real teen wolf, like himself. He and Stiles decide to travel to Hollywood and find her.
Stiles recommends The Wolf Pack to entertain at the Wolverton Festival. However, this bike gang brings big trouble, and Scott must find a way to scare them out of town.

Scott and his family make a trip to Rottenberg, Transylvania in order to reconnect with their past. However, danger lurks when the townspeople seem very spooked by the castle that the family inherited.

'Stool Parrot': The Inspector and Panther must protect a witness to a fifty million diamond robbery...the Parrot. 'Pinky and Slusho': When the Panther's sno-cone business is threatened by Manly Man, the Panther creates Slusho, a talking snowman.

'The Inspector....NOT!': The inspector and the Panther must capture a criminal before the guests at the Cheese Ball are robbed. 'Pink Links': An job penthouse-sitting lands the Panther in the midst of a rivalry between two women golf professionals.

Coconuts acquires a magic wand and magical gadgets from Wes Weasley and warns Sonic, and attempts to master them. Meanwhile, Robotnik tries to change Sonic-themed mobium banknotes into Robotnik banknotes in the Mobius Mint.

Robotnik pursues Breezie and Robotnik Jr. in order to find out why they betrayed him with the intent of building a perpetually loyal robot wife. In a subplot, Junior is in love with Breezie, and enlists Sonic's help in wooing her.
On Sonic's birthday, Tails builds a flying bicycle. Realizing Tails' potential with mechanics, Professor Von Schlemmer invites Tails to be his research assistant.
An intergalactic huntress captures various citizens of Mobius and falls in love with Robotnik during her visit.
Inspector Gadget, Penny, and Brain are off to the Rocky Mountains to rescue a seismologist who M.A.D has captured.
Inspector Gadget foils the evil plans of Dr. Claw to steal a valuable pearl necklace. This adventure takes Chief Quimby and the Inspector to Hong Kong.

Whilst digging for buried treasure, Mr. Bean digs himself a hole too deep to get out of. A local archaeology dig inspires Bean to go in search of treasure. But why buy a metal detector when you can make one from lawnmower parts and a dustbin lid?
Mr. Bean gets a real bug for painting. Then several bugs… and flies and slugs and mice. There’s easy money to be had in the art world and Mr. Bean is set on getting some of it.

Bean fights a losing battle with a winged beast from Hell. When Mr. Bean finds a fly in his room, it's war. He needs weapons. Fly spray? A rolled-up magazine? These are only the start. In desperation, he enlists a mouldy doughnut, an encyclopedia.

The Battle of the Mimes. A leisurely stroll in the park turns into a run when Mr. Bean is chased home by an angry Mime Artist. He is lost for more words than usual when the street performer makes himself at home and insists on being wined and dined.

Mr. Bean finds that cleanliness can be a filthy business. It's the First Day of Spring and Mr. Bean sets about washing his clothes, his furniture, his teddy and himself. But, alas, there’s no hot water!
When a jar believed to contain anti-aging cream of the Pharaohs is stolen from a Ripley exhibit, the BION team travels to Moscow.
Diving in minisubs off the coast of North Carolina with famed treasure hunter Bill Robinson, the BION team digs up a shield belonging to the ancient order of the Knights of the Crusades.
An alien satellite that has been “watching” us for fifty years collides with a NASA shuttle...
